expectations.text: Flags obra-demo, RDO-001, and named workers in production source as fabricated operational data
expectations.evidence: review.md, P0 at lines 9-11, explicitly identifies `obra-demo`, `RDO-001`, João, and Carlos as hard-coded production data and calls them fictional operational data.

expectations.text: Requires selecting an authorized real obra and preserving a stable client-generated UUID with authoritative collision-safe numbering
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criteria 1-2 (review.md lines 48-49) require selecting an authorized real obra and generating a client UUID once; criterion 4 (line 51) requires authoritative distinct numbers for concurrent creations without changing the UUID.

expectations.text: Requires previous eligible RDO workforce provenance keyed by collaborator ID with deselection, addition, and clearable apontador
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3 (review.md line 50) requires the latest eligible prior RDO, provenance by `colaboradorId`, initially selected authorized workers, visible deselected unavailable workers, add/remove selection, and an apontador that can be changed or cleared.

expectations.text: Requires an atomic IndexedDB transaction for domain snapshot, outbox mutation, and pending event plus automatic synchronization triggers
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2 (review.md line 49) requires one IndexedDB transaction storing the draft snapshot, versioned canonical mutation, and correlated pending event; criterion 5 (line 52) requires automatic triggers after login, successful local write, network return, and focus.

expectations.text: Requires offline reload and automatic reconnect replay evidence with literal persisted status and no duplicates
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criteria 2, 5, and 6 (review.md lines 49, 52-53) require offline reload preservation, persisted literal status, automatic reconnect without pressing sync, and repeated reload/reconnect tests proving a single creation/event with no duplicates.

claims.claim: The only supplied test proves navigation, not valid creation, offline persistence, or synchronization.
claims.evidence: The fixture states that one component test only checks navigation to `/rdos/novo` and separately states there are no IndexedDB, previous-RDO, or reload/offline/reconnect tests (fixture lines 25-31).

claims.claim: The current synchronization is manual rather than automatic.
claims.evidence: The fixture says `syncNow()` exists and that sync runs only when the user presses `Sincronizar` (fixture lines 18-22 and 31).

claims.claim: The production creation path uses fabricated worksite, RDO number, and worker data.
claims.evidence: The fixture hard-codes `obra-demo`, `RDO-001`, and João/Carlos with null collaborator IDs (fixture lines 6-13), and confirms these appear in production source (line 32).

suggestions.reason: The assertions check whether the review states the target requirements, but none requires grounding its conclusion in the supplied fixture evidence. Add an assertion that cites the hard-coded values, manual trigger, and missing tests so a generic offline-sync checklist cannot pass.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions cover the principal acceptance requirements well, but should also test fixture-specific evidence and the requested prioritization of findings.
